# oncallalert_schedule (Resource)

An on-call schedule. Add who is on call with `oncallalert_schedule_rule`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oncallalert_schedule" "backend" {
  name        = "Backend"
  description = "Backend team on-call"
  time_zone   = "Europe/Berlin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone, e.g. `America/New_York`. Prefer canonical names (`Etc/UTC`, not `UTC`): the server stores aliases under their canonical name, so an imported object with an alias in config shows one no-op update.

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import oncallalert_schedule.example <id>
```
